name: Stormbringer: Evergale refreshes a Gale charge on Call Lightning (#2813)
contract: Evergale 705717 (Spell.dbc: passive Attributes 448, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA / aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 705716, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) promises "Casting $?s707615[Aeroblast][Call Lightning] now refreshes a charge of Gale". 705716 Unrelenting Gale has one SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESTORE_SPELL_CHARGES with EffectMiscValue 189 and EffectBasePoints 0 + EffectDieSides 1 = 1 charge, handled by Spell::EffectAscensionRestoreSpellCharges -> Player::RestoreSpellChargeCategory(189, 1). SpellChargesCategory 189 is MaxCharges 3 with RecoveryTime 10000 and SpellCharges maps every Gale rank (804036, 570138-570141) to it, so the restore is rank-agnostic. 705717's DBC ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips proc-entry generation and, with no spell_proc row, the aura has no entry in mSpellProcMap and can never fire. Effect[1] of 705717 is aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with EffectBasePoints -1 + EffectDieSides 1 = 0, an inert modifier, so the charge restore is the whole promise. Call Lightning rank 13 (501399) carries SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10, the bit shared with Aeroblast; Arm of Thorim (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x2, no mana cost) is the negative control. Every charge assertion is taken well inside the 10000 ms natural recovery of the spent charges.
